subject: [Invite] London AI Data Leaders Dinner - 23/09
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our CEO, [SENDER] is hosting an intimate roundtable dinner for AI & Data Leaders in London and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at the Coal Office, Kings Cross on Tuesday 23rd September, starting at 6:30 PM. Confirmed attendees include CxOs and senior technical leaders from Synthesia, DeepMind, and Cohere.

It'll be an informal, open-format evening - no slides or pitches, just bringing together like-minded people to discuss their experiences & challenges working with AI data.

Would you be interested in joining / available on the 23rd?

subject: Coffee w/ Encord at DSEI?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Wondering if you or someone from the [COMPANY] team will be in London for DSEI? Would be great to grab a quick coffee if you're available.

I lead the Defence team at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we work several leading teams (Helsing, Maxar, Thales etc) - providing the platform to support a range of data annotation & curation tasks - helping them to iterate faster on the fine-tuning of their AI models.

Let me know if you'll be at the conference, and will be happy to get something on the books,

subject: [NAME] - what's new?
text:
Hey [NAME],

Been a while since you caught up with the team in Chicago earlier this year
- curious to know if there are any plans to scale up annotations in this
later half of the year?

From our side, been an exciting couple of months as we further our support
for Physical AI use cases - working with Boston Dynamics, Physical
Intelligence, and numerous AV customers - to support both VLA and 3D Point
Cloud annotations.

Have also seen a big surge of interest from ex-Labelbox customers following
their pivot towards serving frontier labs & de-prioritising platform
development.

Let me know if it makes sense to catch-up & will be happy to find a time
that works,
